title: Asking a group, answering for us

sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: A question to *ti* is answered from your own side, so it is answered with “we”: *Olvastok? – Igen, olvasunk.* The person changes between the question and the answer, as it did for *te* and *én*. To say no, put *nem* before the verb: *Nem, nem főzünk.*

sections.title: You and someone else
sections.content: When you ask about a friend and the person you are speaking to, the verb takes the *ti* ending: *Meg és te sétáltok?* means “Do Meg and you walk?” Both are being addressed.

items.english: Do you all read? – Yes, we read.
Do you all cook? – No, we do not cook.
Do you all have lunch? – Yes, we have lunch.

sections.content: Do not answer *Olvastok?* with *Olvastok*: that says “you all read”. Say *Olvasunk*, because you are answering about yourselves.
